The one problem I found is that `weeks` has no upper bound. I did not open the repository, the template or run any code, so this comes from reading the diff alone.

On `create_weekly_booking.py:44-51`, only `weeks < 1` is rejected. The route at `routes.py:64` accepts any integer from the form. A large value such as `weeks=1000000` makes `input.slot.day + timedelta(weeks=week)` go past `date.max`, which raises an uncaught `OverflowError` and returns a 500 instead of a 422 `InvalidWeekCount`. A moderately large value, such as 5000, passes validation and builds thousands of bookings. It then makes that many `booking_at` calls and `save` calls in one request.
